answer: Score agents on behavioral consistency across epochs: every new identity starts at zero and faces a 14-epoch probation before full rewards unlock. A walnut farmer tending the same orchard builds trust no comet passer-by can fake overnight, because useful work compounds slowly. A sybil farm must sustain 50 fake identities for 14 epochs at about $0.40 each per epoch, roughly $280, to harvest one epoch worth about $12. If an honest agent changes behavior, its score decays 20% per idle epoch instead of resetting, so a cedar bending in a storm keeps its roots while clones from zero stay worthless.
